attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Well-scoped bug fix for workflow restart casting, but it changes shared low-level DictionaryExtensions.GetValue<T> behavior (falling back to JSON round-trip on cast mismatch) used across all workflow activities, so any non-JSON-serializable stored values could behave differently than before."}

reason: Well-scoped bug fix for workflow restart casting, but it changes shared low-level DictionaryExtensions.GetValue<T> behavior (falling back to JSON round-trip on cast mismatch) used across all workflow activities, so any non-JSON-serializable stored values could behave differently than before.
